description: This C# source file defines a static helper class 'PdfFileHelper' within the 'PdfSharp.TestHelper' namespace. The class provides utility methods for extracting content streams, glyph indices, and font information from PDF documents using the PdfSharp library. It includes methods such as GetPageContentStream, GetPageContentStreamEnumerator, GetHexStringAsGlyphIndices, and GetCurrentFontName.

classes.name: PdfFileHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods for extracting content streams, glyphs, and font information from PDF documents.

methods.name: GetPageContentStream
methods.description: Retrieves the content stream of a specified page in a PDF document as a string.

methods.name: GetPageContentStreamEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator to inspect elements within the content stream of a specified PDF page.

methods.name: GetHexStringAsGlyphIndices
methods.description: Converts a hex string into a sequence of glyph indices by chunking into 4-character segments and removing leading zeros.

methods.name: TryParseDouble
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a double, considering invariant culture settings.

methods.name: GetCurrentFontName
methods.description: Attempts to determine the font name used on a specified page by navigating the content stream.
